result.instructions: Tools for Cuttly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show total clicks and visitor countries for the short link I provide."; "Shorten https://example.com/spring-menu with the alias spring-menu."; "Show clicks by country and device for the short link I provide.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cuttly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cuttly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cuttly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cuttly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cuttly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cuttly_shorten_link
tools.title: Shorten link
tools.description: WRITE: create a Cuttly short link for a long URL, optionally with a custom alias (the part after the slash). Returns the short link, the full link and the page title. It counts against the monthly link limit of the plan. Cuttly rate limit: Free 3 calls per 60 seconds, Starter 6, Single 60. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?short=...

url.description: The long URL to shorten (full http or https URL).

alias.description: Custom alias (back-half), e.g. 'spring-sale'. Fails if it is taken.

use_branded_domain.description: Use the active branded domain of the account instead of cutt.ly (any paid plan).

public_stats.description: Make the click statistics of this link readable through the API without the owner's key (Single plan and up).

tools.name: cuttly_get_link_stats
tools.title: Get link stats
tools.description: Click statistics of one short link: total clicks, clicks by source (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, other, bots), top referrers, countries, device types, operating systems, browsers, device brands and languages. The date range filter needs the Team plan or higher. Counts as one API call (Free plan 3 per 60 seconds). GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?stats=...

link.description: The Cuttly short link, e.g. https://cutt.ly/abc123 (or a link on your branded domain).

date_from.description: Start of the range (Team plan and up).

date_to.description: End of the range (Team plan and up). May be used alone.

tools.name: cuttly_update_link
tools.title: Update link
tools.description: WRITE: change a short link: its alias, destination URL, title, tag or unique-click window. Send only what you want to change. Changing the alias makes the old short link stop working; changing the destination redirects every visitor to the new URL at once. Link editing needs the Single plan or higher. Cuttly sends no previous values back, so ask the user before you change a live link. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?edit=...

link.description: The Cuttly short link, e.g. https://cutt.ly/abc123 (or a link on your branded domain).

new_alias.description: New alias. The old short link stops working. Fails if the alias is taken.

destination_url.description: New destination URL the short link redirects to.

tag.description: A tag to add to the link.

unique_clicks_minutes.description: Unique-click counting: 0 = off, 1 = 15-minute window (Single plan), 15-1440 = custom window in minutes (Team plan and up).

tools.name: cuttly_set_link_expiration
tools.title: Set link expiration
tools.description: WRITE: set or remove the expiration of a short link. The link expires after a number of clicks or on a date, and can then redirect to another URL. mode 'none' removes an existing expiration. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?edit=...&expire=...

link.description: The Cuttly short link, e.g. https://cutt.ly/abc123 (or a link on your branded domain).

mode.description: 'clicks' = expire after `clicks` clicks, 'date' = expire on `date`, 'none' = remove the expiration.

redirect_url.description: Where visitors go after the link expired.

count_unique_clicks.description: Count only unique clicks toward a click threshold.

tools.name: cuttly_set_device_redirect
tools.title: Set device redirect
tools.description: WRITE: send visitors on one device type to another destination (an app store page or a deep link): Android, iOS or Windows Mobile. platform 'redirect' sets the destination for all other devices. Set `remove: true` instead of a destination to delete the rule. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?edit=...&mobile=...

link.description: The Cuttly short link, e.g. https://cutt.ly/abc123 (or a link on your branded domain).

destination.description: URL or deep link for that device type.

remove.description: true = remove the rule of this device type (then do not pass a destination).

tools.name: cuttly_delete_link
tools.title: Delete link
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: permanently delete a short link and its statistics. Anyone who opens the short link afterwards gets an error, and Cuttly cannot restore it. Ask the user to confirm the exact link before you call this. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?edit=...&delete=1

link.description: The Cuttly short link, e.g. https://cutt.ly/abc123 (or a link on your branded domain).
